items.title: Claude Code Hacked to Achieve Full RCE and Hijacked Organization API keys
items.description: Critical vulnerabilities in Anthropic’s Claude Code, an AI-powered command-line development tool. The flaws could allow attackers to achieve Remote Code Execution (RCE) and exfiltrate Anthropic API keys by exploiting project configuration files.
